basic_details.job_title: DRDO LRDE Consultant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Electronics & Radar Development Establishment (DRDO LRDE) has announced vacancies for Consultant (Technical) under a 2026 recruitment drive. Eligible candidates can submit their applications by email or by post to the office on or before 4 November 2026, starting from 14 October 2026. Applicants for the Consultant (Technical) post require a qualification in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or Instrument with 30+ years of experience in Quality and Reliability Assurance, with the pay specified as Level-13A. content_sections.heading: DRDO LRDE Consultant Job Description
content_sections.text: Post Code 2026/LRDE/356: Prepare comprehensive Master Quality Assurance Plan for Radar Projects across Ground, Airborne, Naval, Underwater, and Space-borne applications; perform reliability allocation and MTBF apportionment for LRUs and SRUs. Post Code 2026/LRDE/357: Project management activities, weekly report generation, MOM of meetings, procurement reports, and coordination with industry partners. Post Code 2026/LRDE/358: Integration and testing of radar at LRDE test site in Kolar, Active Array calibration, maintain TR module failure statistics, coordinate repairs, maintain store records, and perform power, cooling, and mechanical checks. Post Code 2026/LRDE/359: Prepare Quality Assurance Test Plans, ensure QC tests at LRDE and vendor premises, document test activities, and coordinate Airworthiness Certification with DGAQA, DGQA, DQAN, DQRS, DSQR, and CEMILAC. Post Code 2026/LRDE/360: Assist in electrical interconnection scheme design between radar subsystems (RF, Digital, Optical, Power Supply), select cables and connectors, generate drawings, and participate in testing. Post Code 2026/LRDE/361: Day-to-day monitoring of civil works, prepare/maintain replies to land-related legal cases, follow up on WoDA notifications, coordinate with MES/EMU, and liaise with state government departments.

faq.question: Q1. What is DRDO LRDE Consultant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a recruitment drive by the Electronics & Radar Development Establishment (DRDO LRDE), Bengaluru, to engage retired government, PSU, and autonomous body officials as Consultants on a short-term contract basis.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: There are a total of 6 vacancies distributed across post codes 2026/LRDE/356 to 2026/LRDE/361, with 1 post per post code.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit applications?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of applications is 4 November 2026, which is 21 days from the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all categories of retired government employees applying for these consultant positions is 63 years as on the closing date of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the contract tenure for these consultant positions?
faq.answer: The tenure of contract is one year, which is extendable as per extant norms, with specific tasks estimated between 1 to 3 years depending on the post code.

faq.question: Q6. How is the remuneration determined for pensioners?
faq.answer: For pensioners, a fixed monthly amount is admissible, arrived at by deducting the basic pension from the pay drawn at the time of retirement, remaining unchanged for the contract term without annual increments.

faq.question: Q7. Can applications be submitted via email?
faq.answer: Yes, completed applications can be sent by email to [email protected] with the subject line “Application for Consultant”, or sent by post to the Director, LRDE, Bengaluru.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any mandatory gap required after retirement?
faq.answer: Yes, no retired Government Servant is eligible for appointment as a Consultant unless there is a gap of at least fifteen (15) days between their retirement and appointment as a consultant.
